title.narrative: Ho Chi Minh City Urban Mass Rapid Transit Line 2 Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: The proposed project supports the development one of three priority urban rail MRT lines in HCMC to support the establishment of a sustainable urban transportation system. The construction of MRT Line 2 (MRT2) will facilitate public transport access and connectivity in six central districts of HCMC, promote a modal shift from private to public transport, and support low-carbon transport that reduces greenhouse gas emissions. The project directly supports implementation of the MRT2 project, and also the development of necessary facilites at the MRT2 depot.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Effective support for implementation of MRT2 infrastructure

MAUR project staff meet necessary skills level standards by 2015 Achievement: N Progress/Status: Partially achieved with delay.
Training commenced and closed when CS1 and CS3 closed in 2017. About 45 MAUR staff have received various training on IT, social - gender and environmental safeguards, procurement, and technical theme in integrated urban transport.
Further training on these aspects is expected to resume from Q3 2022 when the new CS2B (Project Management and Implementation Support) consultant is on board. Data Source: Independent training evaluation reports Base year: 2010 Baseline value: N

Sustainable transport polices implemented as agreed by 2015 Achievement: N Progress/Status: Partially achieved with delay.
CS4 provided HCMC PC/MAUR with recommendation for transport policy. ADB loan project (3113/8279) to supplement implementation of transport policy was approved on 20 February 2014, but due to its substantial delay due to delay of the parent HCMC MRT Line 2 project, this project was closed.
The policies implementation will be deferred till later. Data Source: Monitoring reports from CTF funded project Base year: 2010 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Completion of integrated sustainable urban transport study Indicator: Agreed milestones for policy measures, including gender initiatives in 2012 Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Contract CS4 (Integrated Sustainable Urban Transport) provided HCMC PC/MAUR with recommendation for transport policy. It is necessary for HCMC PC/MAUR to apply the policy. CS3 (Social Development and Gender Mainstreaming program) provided MAUR with Gender Action Plan, which will be reflected in physical infrastructure and implementation arrangements (e.g. female participation in civil works). Data Source: Project review mission reports Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2012 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Completion of integrated sustainable urban transport study Indicator: Integrated sustainable urban transport final report accepted by 2013 Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Contract CS4 (Integrated Sustainable Urban Transport) was completed in June 2017. MAUR accepted the report at the same time. Data Source: Project review mission reports Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2013 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Construction of initial site works and office facilities at depot Indicator: All initial site works and office buildings in Tham Luong depot area constructed by 2013 Achievement: N Progress/Status: Partially achieved with delay.
Contract package CP1 (Office Building and Auxiliary Building at Tham Luong Depot) was physically completed, and all payments have been made to the contractor.
Contract packge CP2 (Infrastructure Construction of Tham Luong Depot) is expected to commence in Q3 2023 under a proposed ADB new loan.
Data Source: Progress reports Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2013 Target value: Y Actual value: N
